design_informed_by: Old8block hardware data and explicitly labelled cached-noise engineering inspected; this is not an independent discovery registration.
target: Average conditional expected signed score over actual complete setting events; not automatically one common quantum-state fidelity.
coordinates: 33 science signed means plus4 transverse full-minus-sensitive-record masked differences. Calibrations descriptive only.
bound: For coordinateY in[a,b], radius=(b-a)*sqrt(log(2J/alpha)/(2N)). Fixed/predictable labels and complete predeclaredN; no iid or stationary-device assumption needed for this conditional-score target.
proof: Write mu_i=E[Y_i|F_(i-1)]. Conditional Hoeffding lemma gives E[exp(lambda(Y_i-mu_i))|F_(i-1)]<=exp(lambda^2(b-a)^2/8). Iteration and Chernoff give P(|mean(Y)-mean(mu)|>=epsilon)<=2exp(-2N epsilon^2/(b-a)^2). Union bound overJ=37. Derived conditional-MGF argument uses known concentration tools; no novelty claim.
interpretation_limit: Averages include actual basis/context/time conditions. Quantum Bell fidelity requires additional trusted common-state/preparation/basis assumptions. No .03 systematic margin assumed or certified.
phase: All12 predeclared phase coordinates; ideal0. No post-hoc Bell phase optimization.
secondary: Prespecified H0 omit bit0/H1 omit bit1; unchanged insensitive controls; no extra shots.
block_error: Report shot counts plus four individual block vectors and paired descriptive t3 intervals; four jobs need not be independent or stationary, so t3 descriptions are not arbitrary-drift confidence guarantees.
operational_decision: Nominal BELL0 lower score>.70 and separation from SEP0 are engineering interpretability flags, not entanglement certificates or publication gates. If baseline poor, retain all results and do not enlarge samples or start further circuit stages.
stop: Always collect only fixed4 approved blocks, or stop on execution/integrity/unknownPOST failure; incomplete dataset not relabelled complete. No new job automatically follows the results.
